messages:
Jordan (Support): Hi @BrightData, noticed your support ticket about embedding upserts failing after your recent pin. Can you paste the exact error and the model you pinned to?
Customer: BrightData: sure — we pinned our workspace to `redwood/text-embeddings:prod` yesterday. Our batch upserts started erroring out with: 
```
ERROR 400 EMB_DIM_MISMATCH: expected vector length 1024 but received 1536 for id=doc_9001
```
We didn't change the index schema or the client.
Jordan (Support): thanks. Can you also paste the last successful upsert log and one failed one? and the SDK call you used (language + args).
Customer: BrightData: here are representative snippets — success from 2026-03-01 14:02 UTC: 
```
Upsert OK: id=doc_8890, len=1024, model=redwood/text-embeddings@sha256:aa11bb22
```
and fail a few hours later at 14:15: 
```
Upsert FAILED: id=doc_9001, len=1536, model=redwood/text-embeddings:prod
```
We used the Python SDK `client.embeddings.create(model=..., input=...)` with default options.
Riley (ML Eng): immediate hypothesis: the `:prod` alias was promoted to a new variant that emits 1536-dim vectors. If a workspace pins to a mutable alias (like `:prod`) it will follow alias changes. Can you run: `curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/redwood/text-embeddings:prod` and paste the JSON manifest?
Customer: BrightData: done, returned: 
```
{"id":"redwood/text-embeddings:prod","embedding_dim":1536,"variant":"text-emb-v2"}
```
Customer: BrightData: uh-oh that shows 1536 now. We expected the old 1024.
Riley (ML Eng): yep confirmed. The manifest indicates the alias now points to a 1536-dim variant. If your index expects 1024, upserts will fail. Two remediation paths: 1) re-pin to the immutable sha of the old 1024 model; 2) migrate/reindex to 1536.
Asha (Platform): I'm checking the promotion logs... deploy-bot: promotion job 2026-03-01T13:58Z executed by asha@redwood.ai -> alias redwood/text-embeddings:prod -> target text-emb-v2 (1536d).
Asha (Platform): I promoted the variant after successful canary. I didn't realize some customers had workspace-level pins to `:prod`. That's on us — we should warn on promotion if there are pinned workspaces.
Jordan (Support): for the customer, which option is faster? re-pin or reindex?
Riley (ML Eng): re-pin is fastest. We can find the previous immutable SHA and share it. Reindexing 2M vectors could take many hours depending on throughput and cost. If you need immediate continuity, re-pin.
Jordan (Support): BrightData — do you have a preference?
Customer: BrightData: we want zero downtime on search. Re-pin if that's easiest. Also can you explain why the Console shows `:prod` without a sha? That's confusing.
Jordan (Support): agreed, console should show the concrete target on hover. I'll file a UI improvement ticket.
Riley (ML Eng): I looked up model history: previous revision is `redwood/text-embeddings@sha256:cc33dd44` with embedding_dim=1024.
Jordan (Support): steps I'm sending you to re-pin: 
```
1) Console -> Workspace Settings -> Model Pinning -> paste `redwood/text-embeddings@sha256:cc33dd44`
2) Restart your indexer worker or run `indexerctl resume`
```
Do you want us to perform the pin on your behalf?
Customer: BrightData: please do. We don't have time to dig in.
Jordan (Support): ok I'll escalate to Platform to perform a workspace-level pin. @Asha can you apply `@sha256:cc33dd44` to workspace id BD-77?
Asha (Platform): on it. Doing config change... deploy-bot: applying workspace pin BD-77 -> redwood/text-embeddings@sha256:cc33dd44
deploy-bot: workspace pin applied successfully at 2026-03-01T15:00Z
IndexerBot: indexer resumed for workspace BD-77, caught up backlog.
Customer: BrightData: confirmed — upserts resumed and errors stopped. Thanks!
Riley (ML Eng): follow-ups: 
- We'll add an automated check in the model promotion workflow to detect pinned workspaces and require an explicit override.
- Add an alert that fires when alias embedding_dim changes (emb-dim-drift) so support/platform see it before customer error.
Asha (Platform): agreed. I'll also add UI copy to the pinning modal that recommends using immutable shas for production indexes.
Jordan (Support): notes for internal: customer avoided reindex by re-pinning. Action items: SR-6290 (support) -> Platform task PLAT-1952 (add promotion safety), ENG-4018 (alert on embedding_dim changes), UX-1287 (pinning modal copy).
Customer: BrightData: appreciate the quick help. Can you also confirm whether there will be billing implications for the re-pin or the failed upserts? We saw a few thousand failed upsert attempts in our logs.
Jordan (Support): failed upserts that return 4xx are not billable; only successful token/embedding units are billed. I'll open a billing exception to review the logs and confirm.
Asha (Platform): logging note — we will also add a metric to report alias->variant changes and email owners when promotions occur for public aliases.
Customer: BrightData: +1 on notifying customers. This was scary during a production index run.
Jordan (Support): I'll follow up in 24h to confirm search quality and close the SR. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
